title: Service Contracts: FEU factors, reefer weighting and re-rating window by tier
content:
## Scope
This reference gives the figures the Aurelia Hanse Line (AHL) Service Contracts product uses when volume from departed bookings is credited against a contract's commitment: the FEU credited per container of each equipment type, the multiplier on the FEU credited for reefer equipment, and the number of calendar days after departure within which a booking may still be re-rated off the contract, reversing its credit.

## FEU credited per container, by equipment type
The same map applies in all six tiers (Starter, Standard, Regional Account, Key Account, Global Account and Strategic Partner).

| Equipment type | FEU per container |
|---|---|
| 20DV | 0.5 |
| 40DV | 1.0 |
| 40HC | 1.0 |
| 45HC | 1.1 |
| 20RF | 0.5 |
| 40RH | 1.0 |
| 20OT | 0.5 |
| 40OT | 1.0 |
| 20FR | 0.5 |
| 40FR | 1.0 |
| 20TK | 0.5 |

## Reefer weighting and re-rating window by tier
| Tier | Reefer weighting (multiplier on reefer FEU) | Re-rating window (calendar days after departure) |
|---|---|---|
| AHL Starter Service Contract | 1.0 | 30 |
| AHL Standard Service Contract | 1.0 | 30 |
| AHL Regional Account Contract | 1.0 | 30 |
| AHL Key Account Contract | 1.2 | 45 |
| AHL Global Account Contract | 1.2 | 45 |
| AHL Strategic Partner Contract | 1.5 | 60 |

The reefer equipment types in the map are 20RF and 40RH.

## Quick questions
**How many FEU does one 45HC container count for?** 1.1 FEU, in every tier.

**Does the reefer weighting change anything in the first three tiers?** No. A multiplier of 1.0 leaves the reefer FEU unchanged; the weighting raises the reefer credit only in the Key Account and Global Account tiers (1.2) and the Strategic Partner tier (1.5).

**How long after departure may a booking on an AHL Strategic Partner Contract still be re-rated off the contract?** Up to 60 calendar days after departure.
